offers_products.reason: Sells CFM56 and V2500 engines, modules, used serviceable material parts and kits.

offers_services.reason: Provides engine and aircraft leasing plus maintenance, repair and exchange services for airlines.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are airlines and aviation operators; no individual or household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Airlines, lessors and aircraft operators buy engine leases, modules, parts and maintenance.

recurring_revenue.reason: Engine and aircraft lease rentals and repeat parts and module orders from airlines make up most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Engine maintenance, exchanges and aftermarket parts are needed to keep aircraft flying; demand is driven by flight activity and repairs.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are engine leases, module exchanges and parts to airlines, which are repeat and moderate relative to airline spending.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from owned engines, parts inventory and repair technology, not mainly staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Customers are airlines and aircraft operators, typically large commercial carriers, leasing engines and buying parts and maintenance.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns a large portfolio of leased aircraft engines and aircraft, needing ongoing capital investment, plus module factory and repair facilities.

notes: The split between leasing, maintenance and parts sales is uncertain; the answers reflect the combined aviation aftermarket business.
